title: MPhil/PhD in Operations Management & Statistics
institution: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST), Department of Information Systems, Business Statistics and Operations Management
about: HKUST's MPhil/PhD in Operations Management & Statistics accepts Fall 2027 applications. The first-round deadline is 31 December 2026 and the second round closes 1 April 2027; later applications are considered only if places remain.
requirements: 1st round deadline 31 December 2026; 2nd round 1 April 2027 (later applications considered only if spots remain)
Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme applicants follow the separate 1 December 2026 HKPFS deadline

upskill.name: Statistical & Mathematical Foundations I
why: Field "Operations management, business statistics" → objective "Apply inferential statistical methods, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and analysis of variance (ANOVA), to draw conclusions from samples."
Field "business statistics" → objective "Build a practical foundation in descriptive statistics by summarizing datasets, examining distributions, and interpreting measures of central tendency."

Field "business statistics" → objective "Introduce Bayesian statistics and probabilistic modelling as approaches for representing uncertainty and updating analytical conclusions as new evidence becomes available."
